artifacts.summary: 4-phase, 3.5-hour plan adding a cross-project --reap mode to the sapience MCP writer and an ungated reap pass to the SessionStart hook, with fixture coverage, docs, redeploy and installer refresh.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new standalone action to a shell writer script, check where the script's top-level resource resolution runs: setup-sapience-mcp.sh resolves its python3 interpreter at top level with a hard 'exit 1' on failure, AFTER the --retire-global short-circuit but BEFORE the normal write path. Any new action that needs no interpreter (e.g. a cross-project reap sweep) must short-circuit alongside --retire-global, not later -- otherwise it inherits an unrelated hard-exit precondition and fails on a machine where that resource is unresolvable.
